title: OBB: Setter Floor Dashboard
subtitle: SID fulfillment engine
_tabsNote: v1 is the fulfillment engine only. The front-end acquisition tabs (overview, ad spend, ROAS) are a separate board in v2. Do not merge them.
_periodNote: A setter floor is a daily-rhythm system, so the default window is short. Longer windows are for trend, not for management.
_funnelNote: Ends at Held. Won/Signed is not tracked in SID (it lives downstream in client sub-accounts), so it is intentionally omitted rather than shown as an empty column.

goals._speedNote: Green under 5 min, yellow 5-15, orange 15-30, red over 30. The monitor agent alerts at the SLA.
goals._dayOneNote: Percent of new leads that receive attempt 1 inside 24 hours. This is the single best predictor of book rate on this floor.
goals._formNote: Percent of worked leads with an Intro Call Form on file. Below this the per-rep numbers cannot be trusted, so the board flags it before it flags anything else.
goals._rampNote: Setters inside rampDays of their start date get a NEW badge and are excluded from the below-SLA warning.

_floorTilesNote: invert = lower is better, so the goal bands reverse. hero = rendered larger. These six answer 'is the floor healthy right now'.
_setterNote: This table IS the Priority-#1 deliverable. Sortable on every column, default sort by bookRate descending. Attempts and dials are separate columns on purpose: the gap between them is how you see the attempt definition working correctly.

insights._note: A ranked priority list generated from the biggest gaps against goals, written as plain instructions to the floor lead, not as statistics. Example: 'Michelle has 14 P1 leads unworked past 30 minutes.' Ranked by leads at risk, not by percentage gap.

privacy._note: The board is aggregate by default. Drill-downs show first name and last initial plus a SID deep link, never a full record. No diagnoses, addresses, dates of birth, or free-text notes ever reach this file. See docs/compliance.md.

footer.dataSourceLine: Source: SID (GoHighLevel). Counts are cumulative by event date, not current pipeline stage.
footer.disclaimer: Internal operating report. Access restricted. Do not export or forward.
